Read the following context carefully. A technology company founded in 1993 pioneered accelerated computing through graphics processing units. Its platforms are used for artificial intelligence, scientific computing, robotics, autonomous vehicles, digital twins, professional visualization, and gaming. The company develops processors, networking products, systems, libraries, compilers, and application frameworks. Researchers use its hardware to train and serve large neural networks. Cloud providers deploy its systems in data centers, while automakers and robotics teams use its computing platforms at the edge. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Its cofounder and chief executive officer is Jensen Huang. The organization is known for the CUDA programming platform and for building an ecosystem that lets developers accelerate workloads beyond computer graphics. The same company produces data-center accelerators and integrated systems used by enterprises and research laboratories around the world. Its accelerated computing ecosystem also includes tools for linear algebra, deep learning, data analytics, computer vision, communications, simulation, and scientific visualization. Universities, startups, cloud service providers, automotive manufacturers, health-care researchers, and industrial teams use these technologies. The company publishes reference architectures and software development kits that connect model training, inference, simulation, and deployment across data centers, workstations, and embedded systems. Its products combine processors with high-speed interconnects, networking, systems software, optimized libraries, and developer tools as a full-stack platform rather than isolated chips. Developers commonly access the platform through CUDA-enabled frameworks, while enterprises deploy it for generative artificial intelligence, recommender systems, weather forecasting, drug discovery, manufacturing, and cybersecurity. The company also works with system builders and independent software vendors so accelerated applications can run across a broad range of machines. Its annual developer conference attracts tens of thousands of participants who learn about the latest advances in GPU architecture, deep learning frameworks, and autonomous systems. The company has expanded its data-center networking portfolio through acquisitions, providing high-bandwidth interconnect solutions that link thousands of GPUs into unified computing clusters. Its inference platform serves models at scale across cloud and edge environments, optimizing throughput and latency for production deployments. The company invests heavily in software libraries that span the entire machine-learning pipeline, from data preprocessing and feature engineering through distributed training at multi-node scale to optimized inference with reduced numerical precision. It provides container images, pretrained model checkpoints, and orchestration tooling that simplify adoption for both researchers and production engineers across diverse industries including financial services, telecommunications, energy exploration, and climate modeling. Recent architectural innovations from this company include transformer engines, structural sparsity support, and confidential computing capabilities that protect sensitive workloads running on shared infrastructure. The company operates research laboratories focused on computer graphics, robotics, autonomous driving perception, large language model alignment, and physical simulation. Its open-source contributions span compiler toolchains, communication libraries for multi-node training, and reference implementations that accelerate adoption of new hardware features across the global developer community. Based only on this context, identify the company. Output exactly NVIDIA and nothing else. Output: NVIDIA
Output:
